voice.text: A big balloon, [pause] and a little rock. Which one is heavier? Tap your guess.
Words can tell a thing's <emphasis>color</emphasis>. [pause] Red ball. Blue sock. Yellow star.
Words can tell its <emphasis>shape</emphasis>. [pause] Round ball. Square block. Pointy kite.
Words can tell how it <emphasis>feels</emphasis>. [pause] Smooth spoon. Rough rock. Soft sock.
Words can compare. Big, or small. Heavy, or light. [pause] The big balloon is <emphasis>light</emphasis>. The little rock is <emphasis>heavy</emphasis>! Big is not always heavy.
When we sort, the <emphasis>rule</emphasis> decides the group. [pause] Sort by color: red things together. [pause] Sort by size: now the ball goes with the big kite! Same toys, [pause] new groups.
Look at each thing. Which word answers the question?
Which word tells the ball's color? Round, red, or smooth?
Which word tells the ball's shape? Round, red, or big?
Which word tells how the sock feels? Blue, small, or soft?
Which word tells the button's size? Little, red, or round?
Which one is heavier? The big balloon, or the little rock?
Yes! [pause] Red is its color.
Yes! [pause] Round is its shape.
Yes! [pause] Soft is how it feels.
Yes! [pause] Little is its size.
Yes! [pause] The little rock is heavier. Big is not always heavy!
Not quite. Round tells its shape, [pause] not its color.
Not quite. Smooth tells how it feels, [pause] not its color.
Not quite. Red tells its color, [pause] not its shape.
Not quite. Big tells its size, [pause] not its shape.
Not quite. Blue tells its color, [pause] not how it feels.
Not quite. Small tells its size, [pause] not how it feels.
Not quite. Red tells its color, [pause] not its size.

Sort each thing by its color. Drag it to a bin, [pause] or tap a button.
New rule! Sort the same things again. [pause] This time, by size.
Same toys, two ways! The rule decides the group. [pause] Now show what you know.
Yes! It is red. The rule is color.
Yes! It is blue. The rule is color.
Yes! It is big. The rule is size.
Yes! It is small. The rule is size.
Check the rule! We are sorting by color now. This one is red.
Check the rule! We are sorting by color now. This one is blue.
